replacement.objective: Use a named line and an explicit practice condition to coordinate a restart.
replacement.briefing: Navy attacks the right net (+x); gold attacks the left net. This simplified timing drill has its own instruction: before the coach releases F1 to continue, YOU must return to the neutral-zone side of the right blue line. YOU are currently beyond that line. F1 waits with the puck. This is a practice reset condition, not a complete offside lesson or an officiating ruling.
cues: The coach requires YOU to reset to the neutral-zone side of the right blue line.
The right blue line separates the neutral zone from the attacking end.
F1 is waiting with the puck on the neutral-zone side.
